🚨 At least three people have been killed and three others critically injured after a vehicle struck pedestrians near a Metro station in North Hollywood, Los Angeles, the city fire department says.

Police are investigating the crash. https://t.co/BfVNFc158j

Follow up: Lebanon has opened a murder probe into the death of former Iraqi MP Ahmed al Alwani, whose body was found in a Beirut apartment.

Early findings point to strangulation. A Lebanese suspect is in custody and two Syrians are still wanted.

Mexico 🇲🇽: Gunmen tied to the Gente del Tena (GDT) cartel caught on camera trading fire with rivals somewhere in Michoacán.

The man filming appears to carry a Romanian made AIMS (PM md. 65) AK rifle, a fairly rare sight. https://t.co/a3A0cShVka

🚨 The United Airlines passenger accused of storming the cockpit and claiming to have a bomb on a Newark to New Orleans flight, triggering a hijack alert, is an illegal immigrant from Honduras who had already been deported twice, DHS says.

Follow up: Houthi led Yemeni forces have reached the Huwairib area of Al Mudaraba in Lahij and are pushing on toward Khor Omaira.

The goal is to complete the encirclement of thousands of Saudi backed troops in Al Mudaraba, Dhubab and Bab al Mandab. https://t.co/bBYToezD2U
🚨 Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has relocated from his home to a US military base following Iranian threats on his life, The New York Times reports. https://t.co/8zdSgNs7f7
The Trump administration is putting a long standing Russian demand, renegotiating security across Europe, at the heart of its latest push to end the war in Ukraine.
Follow up: A fire has been reported at Russia's Ust Luga oil export terminal after the Ukrainian drone attack. https://t.co/pEBjfmRpmn

🚨 Yemen: Houthi led Yemeni forces are reported to have taken the Sarih junction, 20 km from the sea, and reached Jabal Kharaz near Khor Omaira.

Saudi backed forces at Bab al Mandab, Dhubab and Al Mudaraba now face the risk of encirclement.

🚨 Ukrainian drones have struck infrastructure at Russia's Ust Luga seaport in the Leningrad region.

The attack came the same night as a large Ukrainian drone assault on St Petersburg. https://t.co/W9Pi5SJ6lG

Nine Kennedy family members have gone to court to block President Trump's planned 250 foot arch near Arlington National Cemetery.

They say it would mar the family's gravesite, where John F. Kennedy and his brothers Robert and Ted are buried.

A US immigration deportation flight carrying Iranian nationals turned back and landed again in Mesa, Arizona.

Lawyers for the group said they were due to be flown to Pakistan and then handed over to Iran.

Correction: The tanker damaged near Khasab, Oman on November 7 was Navig8 Macallister, not Navig8 Messi, according to the IMO's confirmed incident list.

The IMO now counts 133 confirmed incidents and 25 seafarers killed in the region as of November 10. https://t.co/i22Vz3UfR1

Follow up: Iran says the fire on a South Pars gas platform has been contained.

Seventeen workers jumped into the sea to escape and were all rescued in good condition. Officials are looking at a gas leak or an operational mishap as the cause.

Iran's top security official Mohsen Rezaei says no talks are underway with the United States, dismissing reports of a meeting with Vice President JD Vance in Qatar as false.

It comes hours after Qatar said it had secured a two week window to stop US strikes on Iran.

Iranian security analyst Mahdi Mohammadi says Iran needs a military strategy against economic and psychological pressure, and that lifting the blockade is worth a full scale war.

He says Iran's military leaders have "highly creative ideas" for it.

Follow up: House Republicans blocked Rep. Thomas Massie's push to impeach War Secretary Pete Hegseth.

By 211 to 204, the House sent the resolution to the GOP controlled Judiciary Committee, where it is unlikely to advance. Massie was the lone Republican against.

Trump may soon name the first male White House press secretary since Sean Spicer in 2017.

Conservative commentator Ben Ferguson is emerging as a frontrunner for the job, sources tell Fox News Digital.
🚨 Ukraine is reported to have launched a huge drone attack on St Petersburg tonight, with hundreds of drones fired along varied flight paths toward the Russian city.
